stats.note: indistinguishable from gaussian_RGB:1 on sigma (noise precedes blur → subtype accuracy 54.7%); kept for cross-family coverage

analysis.mode: SIGNAL (sigma=2.22; PSNR invalid due to noise)
analysis.rationale: Three-step mixed degradation in generation order noise(p0)→blur(p1)→jpeg(p2). JPEG: block_boundary=2.9022 (0% FP) confirms compression; full-context severity scan (jpeg3 match, jpeg4 diff 39%, jpeg5 diff 105%) selects sev3 (q=12). Blur: residual_anisotropy=1.7022>1.7 + blur_pca_ratio=4.625>2.5 → motion; motion:5 reproduces spectral_slope on pair0 and pairs 1/4; motion:4 and gaussian:5 fail; support pair 4 gives full 5/5 MATCH including Wiener-kernel. Noise: gaussian_RGB:1 matches wavelet sigma 5/5 pairs; subtype not diagnosable because noise precedes blur (54.7%), noise_prior flat slope + rgb_ratio=1.06 favor gaussian_RGB; impulse:1 indistinguishable → alternative. Residual Wiener/FWHM mismatches on some pairs are caused by per-call random motion-blur angle (uniform -90..90) and pre-blur noise seed mismatch, not by wrong parameters.
